brief: @buildthis.bisks.net An ambient music generator in the style of Brian Eno's "Music for Airports" but that uses a triangle slider for the dimensions of Valence–Arousal–Dominance (VAD) that shapes the generated tones and frequencies, with a "Play" button
note: built vadrone: drag a dot inside a Valence/Arousal/Dominance triangle and an Eno-style drone ensemble bends its pitch, tempo, register and brightness to match, live, while it plays.
